paths.@repo/db/client: Apps and packages read the database through @repo/db/operations/*. Compose several operations with withTransaction from @repo/db/transaction.
paths.@aws-sdk/client-s3: Object storage goes through @repo/storage, which owns the client, the presigned-upload flow and the key-ownership checks.
paths.resend: Email goes through @repo/email, which owns the Resend client, its retry policy and the log transport.

patterns.message: @repo/features is the top of the package graph: apps import it, nothing under packages/ does. A package that needs business logic is a sign that logic belongs in features. See docs/architecture.md.

patterns.message: Apps reach the database, auth, storage and email only through @repo/features/*. From an app, only an infra package's ./env subpath (env composition) and @repo/auth/client (the browser SDK) are importable. See docs/architecture.md.
